items.title: Ray Vega interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 20, 2023
items.q: So this is Mitzy and then this is Ella.

ctx.x: I got that from Ray Barretto, from Mongo, from Tito Puente, oh my God, they read me the riot act. It wasn’t going to be a walk in the park. And from all the — my thing was learn from the bandleaders. Shut your mouth and learn from the older cats. Because they’re there. You know? So I don’t know — how did this one go? You know? Next time we have to have all three dogs. So this is Mitzy and then this is Ella.
